name: Hammerhead
alterEgo: A consistent civilian name is not used in this record
summary: Hammerhead is a flat-skulled crime boss in Spider-Man’s underworld, styled after old gangster films. He is a Maggia-era antagonist, not a science accident like the Lizard or Electro.
creators: Gerry Conway and John Romita Sr.
powers: A steel-strengthened skull and the criminal organization around it.
origin: A gangster rebuilt after an injury, with a metal plate that becomes his weapon.
